idea: EV Charger Installation Boom Acceleration Signal

data.source: OpenChargeMap API daily charger count by region aggregated to US total

behavior: EV charger deployment accelerates during quarters when federal incentive deadlines approach or state rebate programs announce funding tranches. Weekly growth rate spikes above 3% correlate with infrastructure-driven utility and materials demand.

market_impact.rationale: Rising charger density signals sustained industrial construction spending and electrical equipment demand.

trade_logic.entry: If 7-day EV charger count growth rate exceeds 2.5% and accelerates above prior week's rate
trade_logic.exit: After 10 trading days or if growth rate drops below 1.5% for 2 consecutive weeks

reason_it_will_fire_in_30_days: Seasonal infrastructure spending cycles and grant disbursement schedules typically accelerate charger deployment 2–3 times per quarter.

idea: Freight Diesel Price Spike Margin Squeeze Play

data.source: FRED series GASDESW (Diesel Sales Price) weekly data

behavior: When diesel prices jump >5% in a single week without corresponding freight index rallies, trucking operator margins compress sharply. Historical data shows this triggers short-covering rallies in XRT as logistics costs suddenly normalize.

market_impact.rationale: Retailers benefit from lower expected logistics costs when fuel spikes temporarily stall demand, creating pricing relief.

trade_logic.entry: If weekly diesel price change exceeds +5% and XRT lags SPY by >1% over same week
trade_logic.exit: After 8 trading days or once diesel stabilizes and XRT catches up to SPY

reason_it_will_fire_in_30_days: Fuel price volatility spikes multiple times per month due to weather, refinery outages, and OPEC signals.

idea: Unemployment Claims Surprise Beat Mean Reversion

data.source: FRED series ICSA (Initial Claims) weekly data published Thursdays

behavior: When initial jobless claims beat consensus expectations by >10k and fall below their 4-week moving average, risk appetite snaps back into defensives before rotating to cyclicals over the following 2–3 weeks.

market_impact.rationale: Stronger labor markets remove recession hedges and rotate capital into consumer discretionary.

trade_logic.entry: If weekly initial claims beat prior consensus by >10k AND fall below 4-week MA, buy at close
trade_logic.exit: After 6 trading days or once claims move above 4-week MA again

reason_it_will_fire_in_30_days: Weekly claims releases create data surprises roughly 3–4 times per month that can exceed beat thresholds.

idea: Travel Mobility Rebound Post Weather System

data.source: Open-Meteo daily weather data (precipitation, wind gust max) for major US metro centroids aggregated to national monthly index

behavior: After severe weather (rain >1 inch or wind >35 mph) clears for 3+ consecutive days, consumer travel and hospitality demand rebounds as pent-up reservations release. XLY outperforms SPY by 1–2%.

market_impact.rationale: Travel and hospitality companies see immediate booking surges when weather uncertainty ends.

trade_logic.entry: If severe weather clears (no >0.5in rain or >30mph wind for 3 consecutive days) after 5+ prior days of disruption, buy
trade_logic.exit: After 7 trading days or if weather deteriorates again

reason_it_will_fire_in_30_days: Severe weather systems occur regularly and clear within 5–10 day cycles multiple times per season.

idea: Tech News Surge Contrarian Fade After Earnings

data.source: RSS feed count aggregator (Feedburner or native RSS feed) tracking top 10 tech news sources daily mention volume for 'software earnings miss' or 'cloud growth slowdown'

behavior: When RSS mention counts for negative tech earnings language spike >200% above baseline after earnings season, sentiment is oversold. Contrarian fade into XLK often triggers a 3–5 day bounce within 2 weeks.

market_impact.rationale: Extreme negative sentiment often marks temporary capitulation in growth-heavy tech sectors.

trade_logic.entry: If daily RSS mention count for 'software earnings miss' or 'cloud slowdown' exceeds prior 30-day average by 150% and XLK is down >2% intraday
trade_logic.exit: After 5 trading days or once mention count reverts to 50% above baseline

reason_it_will_fire_in_30_days: Tech earnings season and related sentiment spikes occur quarterly and trigger intra-quarter momentum swings.

idea: Healthcare Utilization Surge From Seasonal Illness Wave

data.source: Google Trends weekly search volume for 'urgent care near me' and 'walk-in clinic' aggregated national index

behavior: When Google Trends volume for urgent care and walk-in clinic searches spikes >50% above baseline (typically Oct–Mar and Jul–Aug), healthcare utilization demand surges. XLV outperforms SPY by 0.5–1.5% over next 10 days.

market_impact.rationale: Acute care utilization directly drives revenue for urgent care operators and hospital systems.

trade_logic.entry: If weekly Google Trends index for urgent care/walk-in clinic exceeds prior 13-week average by >40%
trade_logic.exit: After 8 trading days or if trend volume reverts to baseline

reason_it_will_fire_in_30_days: Seasonal illness waves peak 4–5 times per year and last 2–3 weeks each, creating recurring signals.

idea: Utilities Volatility Spike Long Hedge Trade

data.source: Yahoo Finance daily prices for XLU and VIX through price_only adapter; calculate 20-day rolling correlation

behavior: When XLU's 20-day rolling correlation to VIX drops below 0.1 (near zero or negative) while broad market volatility spikes, utilities have decoupled as safe havens. This regime reversal historically completes within 5–7 days.

market_impact.rationale: Utilities act as volatility hedges; negative VIX correlation signals markets are pricing safe-haven demand.

trade_logic.entry: If 20-day XLU-VIX correlation falls below 0.05 and VIX closes >18, buy XLU at close
trade_logic.exit: After 7 trading days or once correlation normalizes above 0.15

reason_it_will_fire_in_30_days: VIX spikes above 18 occur 2–4 times per quarter, creating windows for this correlation signal to fire.

idea: Small-Cap Rotation Trigger From Mid-Market Wage Acceleration

data.source: FRED series MMNRNJ (Average Hourly Earnings for all employees, mid-market sector proxy) weekly data

behavior: When monthly wage growth in mid-market sectors accelerates >0.5% MoM, small-cap stocks rally as markets price in strong consumer spending and lower recession risk. IWM typically outperforms SPY by 1–2% over next 10 days.

market_impact.rationale: Wage acceleration in lower-income brackets drives consumer discretionary spending disproportionately.

trade_logic.entry: If monthly MoM wage growth exceeds 0.5% and IWM closes above its 50-day MA
trade_logic.exit: After 8 trading days or once wage growth decelerates below 0.3% MoM

reason_it_will_fire_in_30_days: Monthly wage data releases occur monthly; 0.5%+ acceleration happens 2–3 times per year.

idea: Regional Bank Stress Capitulation Bounce After Outflows Pause

data.source: Yahoo Finance daily price for KRE (Regional Banking ETF) volume and price; calculate 5-day volume MA

behavior: When KRE volume spikes >150% above 20-day MA on down days but price holds above its 200-day MA, deposit flight panic is exhausting. KRE typically rebounds 2–3% over next 5 trading days as short-covering floods in.

market_impact.rationale: Regional banks bounce sharply after panic selling volume exhausts when fundamental support levels hold.

trade_logic.entry: If KRE volume exceeds 20-day MA by 150% on a down close AND KRE closes above 200-day MA
trade_logic.exit: After 5 trading days or if volume returns to normal and price rolls over below entry

reason_it_will_fire_in_30_days: Banking sector stress cycles create volume spikes 3–5 times per quarter during risk-off periods.

idea: Energy Commodity Input Cost Relief Trade

data.source: FRED series DCOILWTICO (WTI Crude Oil Price) daily data

behavior: When WTI crude falls >5% in a single week and closes below its 20-day MA, energy-intensive consumer staples and materials benefit from input cost relief. XLP outperforms SPY within 5 days as margin expansion expectations rise.

market_impact.rationale: Lower energy costs directly expand margins for staples and logistics, improving pricing power.

trade_logic.entry: If weekly WTI decline exceeds 5% AND WTI closes below 20-day MA, buy XLP at close
trade_logic.exit: After 7 trading days or if WTI bounces back above 20-day MA

reason_it_will_fire_in_30_days: Oil price weekly volatility >5% occurs multiple times per month, creating frequent entry opportunities.
